digest.component_or_area: Reliability oracle tests – subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Production-scale real-time values (10s low-speed window, 15s loopback server, 1s per-attempt deadline, 2s/4s retry sleeps) in two reliability test oracles cause multi-second wall-clock overhead per test matrix cell without serving the test contracts.

Slow-progress sentinel must retain real loopback socket and byte-pacing semantics while injecting a sub-second trigger window and transferring above floor threshold for one complete configured window to validate non-stall behavior.

ACLI read-retry sentinel must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe the logical 2s/4s retry schedule without blocking on retry sleeps, and record/poll all parent-side PIDs to prove cleanup after terminal failure.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged and byte-identical across the modified test files.
